page.layout: One printed page: running text inside an ornamental border. Running head at top, page number at top left. No margin notes. Text ends with the hyphenated line "flu-" at the foot of the frame.

main_text.p: diabolicis mediis se ista adepturos sibi pollicerentur, quorum finis est juxta opera illorum. At idem tamen Apostolus non omnē divitiarum usum tollit, aut omne studium parandi opes ex benedictione Dei impedit. Addit enim: Iis qui divites sunt in hoc seculo, denuncia; ne efferantur animo, neq; spem ponant in divitiis incertis: sed in Deo vivo, qui præbet nobis omnia copiosè ad fruendum & cætera, quæ sequuntur.

Rursus instant, & verbis Salomonis nos urgent, sic orantis; Mendicitatem & divitias ne dederis mihi, tribue tantùm victui meo necessaria: Ne forte satiatus illiciar ad negandum; & dicam, Quis est Dominus? Proverb.30.&c.

page.notes: The last line reads "flu-" set flush right, the hyphen as printed; the line before it ends "af-". Show-through from the facing page appears at the right edge and is left out. A faint mark below the last line at left ("ib" or "dis") is not clearly printed text and is not transcribed. Edge-of-page marks and the printer's hand symbol before "Ergò" are not transcribed.
